description: This file defines a custom exception class `JobNodeIdMismatchingException` used within the Apache Fineract project to handle mismatches in job node IDs during execution. It extends the `AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException` to incorporate standard exception features within the platform.

classes.name: JobNodeIdMismatchingException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating a mismatch in node ID during job execution in the platform.

methods.name: JobNodeIdMismatchingException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating the provided node ID does not match the expected node ID.
